why: Cohen, Pohoata, and Zakharov report a new upper bound of n^(-7/6+o(1)) for the Heilbronn triangle problem (2025), improving their own 2023 n^(-8/7-1/2000) bound; this is the problem's own quantity (max triangle area lower bound over point configurations) moving post-snapshot.
